note: Re-judged 2026-10-26 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change, after ece74e2827 (spec-bgp-rs-replacement-on-withdrawal). RFC 2545 Section 3: "In all other cases a BGP speaker shall advertise to its peer in the Network Address field only the global IPv6 address of the next hop (the value of the Length of Network Address of Next Hop field shall be set to 16)." The only change is to the tagged carrier test/plugin/rfc2545-joint-subnet.ci: every peer gains the relay grant line attach process rs { receive [ update-received ]; send [ update ]; } for the declared internal rs process, which the rs fast path requires since 2de6f30f3b to forward at all. No expect or reject changed: the positive (split-link, entity-off-link and recipient-off-link cases) still requires the exact MP_REACH 800E1C0002011020010DB8000B00000000000000000009 (next hop length 0x10, global 2001:db8:b::9 alone) with unchanged NLRI and no withdrawal, and rejects FE80...0009 anywhere on the connection; the negative (same-link) still requires the full 32-octet pair, so a speaker stripping every link-local turns it red. All other tagged units are byte-identical. The carrier is needs-linux (net-admin) and has not yet run on the new config (ece74e2827); that run is owed, the proof it would give is unchanged. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history.
